description: This Java class represents a model used to encapsulate startup error details, including the error throwable and its stack trace, for use within the startup error filtering process in the OpenMRS web application.

classes.name: StartupErrorFilterModel
classes.description: A model object that stores information about startup errors, including the throwable and its full stack trace, for use in the startup error filter.

methods.name: StartupErrorFilterModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Throwable, capturing the error and its stack trace.
